name: @educateos/cartridge
description: EducateOS Thin Common Cartridge importer (roadmap §5.3, PR C04): a bounded .imscc reader and a DTD-free manifest parser that map web links into Content Studio quarantine, LTI links into external-tool references launchable only through an approved @educateos/lti tool registration, and the organization into a proposed curriculum outline. A library, not a deployable Worker.
